works.h2: You need something. Someone can help.
works.step2: Find someone nearby who can help.
works.step3: Connect directly and agree on the details.
works.examples: It could be a driver, a van, a moving service, construction equipment, a tool, a delivery or simply someone with the right skills and time.

need_driver.body1: Sometimes you don't need a taxi. You just need someone to drive your own car.
need_driver.body2: Rotabo connects you with a verified driver who comes to you and drives you home in your own car when you can't or shouldn't drive.

need_other.vehicle_desc: Find someone with the right vehicle for your journey, delivery or job.
need_other.moving_desc: Connect with someone who can help you move furniture, belongings or anything else that needs transporting.
need_other.equipment_desc: Find tools, machines and construction equipment for the job you need to get done.
need_other.hand_desc: Find someone with the skills, experience or time to help.
need_other.unexpected_desc: Tell Rotabo what you need. Someone nearby may be able to help.

offer.body: Tell Rotabo what you can offer and connect with people who need it.
offer.keep_body: Rotabo doesn't take a percentage of what you make.

idea.body1: Everywhere in the world, people need help. And everywhere in the world, someone has the time, skills, equipment or resources to help.
idea.body2: The problem is often simple: they just can't find each other. Rotabo brings them together.
idea.closing2: Have something to offer? Someone needs it.

problem.h2: The problem with every other option
problem.cross3: No coming back for it tomorrow.
problem.cross4: No second ride to collect it.
problem.thesis: Just you, your car, and the way home.

how.step3_desc: They drive your car, with you in it.
how.step4_desc: You arrive together. The car stays yours the whole way.
how.not_taxi1: Not a taxi. Not a ride. Not a car left behind.
how.driver_step1_desc: Create your driver listing and pay for visibility.
how.driver_step2_desc: See people looking for a driver on your dashboard.
how.driver_step3_desc: Call someone who needs a ride, meet them, and drive their car.
how.driver_step4_desc: Settle the fare directly with them at the end.
how.driver_not_taxi1: Not a taxi shift. Not a rental.

recruit.title: Rotabo is looking for drivers. Everywhere.
recruit.lead: We're starting a worldwide search for people who want to drive so that someone else doesn't have to.
recruit.req: You don't need a car. You don't need a company. You need a valid licence, a clear head, and a reason to show up.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Someone lists themselves as looking for a driver in your city. You see their name and phone number. You call the ones you want. You drive their car, with them in it, and they get home safe.

where.title: Where
where.body: Anywhere. Rotabo is live in 38 languages from day one. If nobody drives in your city yet, be the first — early drivers get every request that comes in.

safety.h2: Drivers who drive for a reason
safety.check1: Every driver joins to keep someone off the road who shouldn't be on it
safety.check2: Identity and licence confirmed before the first journey
safety.check3: A shared code of conduct, agreed by everyone who drives
safety.check4: Share your live journey with anyone you choose
safety.check5: Rate every driver, report any incident

partners_card.p: Let your guests enjoy the evening and still drive home in their own car. Offer Rotabo at the table, at reception, or at the door.

investors_card.p: Rotabo connects people across 10 categories in 38 languages, worldwide — no commission taken from anyone who offers their time, skills, or equipment. We're talking to people who back that model.

drivers_card.p: Every journey you take is one nobody takes badly. Choose your own hours, drive cars you never have to own, and get people home the way they wanted to go.

supporters.p: Rotabo is kept going by anyone willing to stand behind the idea that nobody should drive when they shouldn't.
supporters.invite: We especially welcome banks, insurers, sports brands, energy-drink and soft-drink makers — and any business that stands behind sober driving.
supporters.first: No supporters yet — be the first name on this list.

footer.legal: Rotabo is a technology platform. Drivers are independent providers, not employees of Rotabo.

install_modal.title: Add Rotabo to your home screen
install_modal.generic: Open your browser's menu and look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install_modal.ios_step1: Tap the Share button in Safari's toolbar (the square with an arrow pointing up).
install_modal.ios_step2: Scroll down the share menu and tap "Add to Home Screen".
install_modal.ios_step3: Tap "Add" in the top-right corner — done.

verify_modal.title: Check your email
verify_modal.subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to the email below. Enter it to continue.
verify_modal.error: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
verify_modal.spam_hint: Don't see it? Check your Spam or Junk folder — first emails from a new sender sometimes land there.

visibility.email_hint: Use a real address — we'll send a verification code here before your listing goes live.
visibility.phone_hint: Include your country code — this number will be visible to whoever is browsing.
visibility.address_hint: This will be visible to whoever is browsing, same as your phone number.
